prediction.likelyOutcome: 7205 Telegraph is likely to prevail on liability for breach of the condominium instruments (the 30-space requirement), given the Association's own expert's admission that 12 spaces was zoning-deficient and the undisclosed Board conflict of interest, but the damages award will likely land well below the landlord's most aggressive $1,340,000 diminution theory since no appraisal was done at the actual 12-space allocation. The Association has a real, likely-successful offsetting counterclaim for unpaid dues since late 2017, which will reduce net recovery, and unresolved limitations and fee-shifting questions add further variance.

outcome.description: After a bench trial the Fairfax County Circuit Court entered judgment for 7205 Telegraph on all four counts, awarding $481,434.84 in lost-rent contract damages, a further $6,296.70 for over-assessments, release of the association's liens, and $324,977.60 in attorney's fees and costs. A Court of Appeals panel affirmed on April 25, 2023; rehearing en banc was granted, and on December 19, 2023 the court lifted the stay and left the judgment affirmed.
outcome.finalNote: Affirmed, including after rehearing en banc.
